blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each local filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a back-projection space that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 监督的深入学习已经推进了稀少的地形图重建. 然而,传统的模型,一般是绘制过滤后期投影图(FBP)图像或感官图来清理重建,它们都是在分发的变换中闪烁。 由于每当投影计数和角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布发生变化时,它们都需要再培训,因此它们在现实世界应用中的部署仍然有限。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了TomoTransformer,一种基于变压器的架构,它将每个本地过滤的投影作为单个符号,并通过自觉预测缺失的视图. 关键的是,TomoTransformer在后投影空间中运行,将不同空间位置的预测分开,使视差插值几何性能好,对探测器大小不具有变化性. 这种设计产生一个单一的基础模型,可以在任意的角位置和探测器维度处理任何数量的输入预测,并在不进行再培训的情况下查询任何数量的靶角. Tomo Transformer对各种解剖、材料和分辨率进行有效的概括。 对若干基准稀有观点数据集的广泛评价表明,TomoTransformer明显超过VideoTrans等同时存在的多目的模型,与特定协议的有力基线相匹配或超过,同时对投入和目标预测的数量完全不可知。 此外,该模型还显示,从X射线同步激素收集的真正实验性纳米规模的大脑数据具有强力零射一般化作用,显示出其对现实世界应用的实用性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Computed tomography (CT) ( Kak and Slaney, 2001 ) is among the most widely used imaging modalities for volumetric reconstruction, with many applications in biology ( Eisenstein et al., 2023 ; Bosch et al., 2025 ) , material science ( Holler et al., 2017 ) , and medicine ( De Chiffre et al., 2014 ) , to name a few. The objective of tomographic imaging is to reconstruct a 3D volume from a set of 2D projections acquired at different angles. Under dense angular sampling and noise-free conditions, filtered back-projection (FBP) ( Kak and Slaney, 1988 ) is optimal and provides a closed-form inverse via the Fourier slice theorem. In practice, CT projections are acquired at discrete angular locations and are inherently affected by measurement noise. Constraints on radiation dose and scanning time often limit the number of acquired projections, motivating the even more challenging scenario of sparse-view CT. In that setting, the incomplete noisy measurements make image reconstruction an ill-posed inverse problem, where FBP can produce streaking artifacts and lose structural and fine-scale details.
blocks.zh: 计算成像法(CT)(Kak和Slaney,2001年)是体积重建中最广泛使用的成像模式之一,在生物学(Eisenstein等人,2023年;Bosch等人,2025年),材料科学(Holler等人,2017年),医学(De Chiffre等人,2014年)等应用很多. 地形成像的目标是从不同角度获得的一组2D投影中重建一个3D卷. 在密集的角采样和无噪声条件下,滤波背投影(FBP)(Kak和Slaney,1988年)是最佳的,通过Fourier切片定理提供闭式反射. 在实践中,CT预测是在离散角位置获得的,并受到测量噪声的内在影响. 对辐射剂量和扫描时间的限制往往限制已获得的预测数量,从而促使人们面对更具有挑战性的零星CT情景。 在这个背景下,不完全的噪音测量使图像重建成为一个反向问题,FBP可以产生螺旋状的文物,并失去结构和细微的细节。

blocks.en: A large body of work has addressed sparse-view CT through model-based iterative reconstruction with hand-crafted priors, including total variation ( Sidky and Pan, 2008 ) and wavelet sparsity, which partially suppress artifacts at the expense of iterative (slow) optimization. Over the past decade, supervised deep learning has emerged as the dominant alternative, providing faster inference and higher reconstruction quality. The common approach is post-processing of an initial estimate (e.g., an FBP reconstruction from a sparse sinogram) into a clean image ( Kang et al., 2017 ; Adler and Öktem, 2018 ; Han and Ye, 2018 ; Chen et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Yang and others, 2023 ; Ayad et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大量工作通过基于模型的迭代重建与手工前身解决了稀有的CT,包括总变异(Sidky和Pan,2008年)和波浪溅射,部分压制了文物,牺牲了迭代(慢)优化. 在过去十年中,有监督的深入学习已成为主要的替代办法,提供了更快的推论和更高的重建质量。 常见的方法是将初步估计(如FBP重建从一个稀少的天线图)进行后处理成干净的图像(Kang等人,2017年;Adler和Öktem,2018年;Han和Ye,2018年;Chen等人,2018年;Wang等人,2022年;Yang等人,2018年). 2023; Ayad等人, 2024 ).

blocks.en: Despite their empirical success, existing supervised methods commonly have three fundamental limitations: (i) each model is trained for a specific acquisition geometry (i.e., a fixed projection count and angular range); (ii) each model is designed for a fixed image and detector size; and (iii) limited generalizability, a model is trained on a single, narrow data distribution (e.g., a single anatomical region). For instance, a network trained on 60-view sinograms cannot be deployed on a 90-view acquisition without retraining or architectural changes, and is similarly tied to the image, detector size, and data distribution used at training time. It is therefore, highly desirable to have a general model that could accommodate for and be robust to this variability. In line with the recent trend of developing foundations models, a single model trained at scale and adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks and conditions ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Wasserthal et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , we advocate for a foundation model for CT reconstruction capable of ingesting arbitrary sparse acquisitions, with varying view counts, angular configurations, and detector resolutions. Recent attempts to partially achieve this goal have been made by ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , which uses a transformer to predict missing views from raw sinograms. However, ViewTrans is still tied to a fixed detector size and image resolution, limiting its practical utility.
blocks.zh: 尽管在经验上取得了成功,但现有的监督方法通常有三个基本限制:(一)每个模型都为特定的获取几何学(即固定投影计数和角距)而训练; (二)每个模型都为固定图像和探测器大小设计; (三)通用性有限,一个模型就单个,狭义的数据分布(如单一解剖区)而训练. 例如,未经再培训或改变建筑结构,在90视图的获取上无法部署一个经过60视图的感应图培训的网络,它同样与培训时使用的图像、探测器大小和数据分布相挂钩。 因此,非常需要有一个能够适应和有力应对这种变化的一般模式。 根据最近发展基础模型的趋势,我们主张采用一个规模化的单一模型,以适应广泛的下游任务和条件(Bommasani等人,2021年;Brown等人,2020年;Kirillov等人,2023年;Wasserthal等人,2023年;He等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年)。 ViewTrans(Chen等人,2026年)最近曾试图部分实现这一目标,他使用变压器来预测原始星图中缺失的视图. 然而,VideoTrans仍然与固定的探测器尺寸和图像分辨率联系在一起,限制了其实用性.

blocks.en:
We propose TomoTransformer , a transformer-based architecture that treats each local filtered projection as a token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Unlike ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , which operates on raw sinograms and is tied to a fixed detector size, TomoTransformer acts in a local disentangled back-projection space. By decoupling projections across spatial patches, our approach renders view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector dimensions. As a result, a single trained model maps any number of input projections of arbitrary detector resolution to any higher number, without retraining or architectural changes. We train this model on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, and demonstrate its generalization by transferring the pretrained model zero-shot to nanoscale brain tomography. Our experiments show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and
matches or exceeds strong single-purpose baselines that are specifically trained for each acquisition protocol, while remaining agnostic to the number of input and queried projections. Our contributions are as follows. • We introduce TomoTransformer , a CT reconstruction model that is simultaneously agnostic to the number and angular configuration of projections, and detector size , removing the protocol dependence that limits existing supervised methods. • We formulate sinogram completion in a disentangled space which makes view interpolation geometrically natural, yielding a flexible and scalable architecture. • We train TomoTransformer on a large-scale dataset of medical CT anatomies and natural images, showing that a single set of weights generalizes across anatomies, materials, and resolutions, including zero-shot transfer to real experimental data of nanoscale brain ptychography X-ray tomography acquired at Swiss Light Source (SLS) ( Bosch et al., 2025 ) . • We show that TomoTransformer matches or outperforms protocol-specific baselines that are trained individually at each sparsity level, and significantly outperforms the concurrent multi-purpose baseline ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , which is tied to a fixed detector size. • We evaluate the robustness of TomoTransformer against noise where our experiments show that a TomoTransformer pre-trained on clean images achieves remarkable zero-shot denoising performance on unseen noisy projections without any fine-tuning, demonstrating its practical utility for real-world imaging tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been the dominant architecture for learning-based tomographic reconstruction. FBPConvNet ( Jin et al., 2017 ) and tight-frame U-Net variants ( Han and Ye, 2018 ) established the U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) as a strong backbone, and subsequent work extended this idea with directional wavelets ( Kang et al., 2017 ) , attention gating ( Yang and others, 2023 ) , and dual-domain pipelines that jointly process sinograms and images ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . A parallel line of work unrolls iterative solvers into learnable networks ( Chen et al., 2018 ; Adler and Öktem, 2018 ) , embedding the Radon operator into the architecture and improving data consistency and model generalization. However, these methods are not scalable as they always need to process the whole image, as opposed to U-Net-like architectures that can process local patches. More recently, transformer-based reconstructors like DuDoTrans ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , CTTR ( Shi and others, 2022 ) , ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) or TD-STrans ( Chen and others, 2024 ) replace convolutional backbones to capture the global structure of the sinogram that local convolutions miss. Despite these advances, all existing models remain tied to a fixed acquisition protocol and detector resolution, requiring full retraining whenever projection counts or angles change thus limiting their practical utility.
blocks.zh: 革命神经网络(CNNs)一直是以学习为基础的地形图重建的主导架构. FBPConvNet(Jin等人,2017年)和紧框架U-Net的变体(Han and Ye,2018年)建立了U-Net(Ronneberger等人,2015年)作为强大的骨干,随后的工作以方向波(Kang等人,2017年),注意力Gating(Yang等人,2023年),以及联合处理感官图和图像的双域管(Zhang等人,2018年)扩展了这一想法. 并行的工作线将迭代解析器滚动到可学习的网络(Chen等人,2018年;Adler和Öktem,2018年),将拉顿运算符嵌入架构中,提高数据一致性和模型泛化. 然而,这些方法由于总是需要处理整个图像,而不是可以处理局部补丁的类似U-Net的架构,因此是无法扩展的. 最近,以变压器为基础的重建器如DuDoTrans(王等人,2022年),CTTR(史等人,2022年),VideoTrans(陈等人,2026年)或TD-STrans(陈等人,2024年),取代了革命骨干,以捕捉当地流传下来的罪恶图的全球结构. 尽管取得了这些进展,但所有现有的模型仍与固定的购置协议和探测器解析有关,在投影计数或角度发生变化时都需要进行全面再培训,从而限制了其实际用途。

blocks.en: A second class of methods casts reconstruction as posterior sampling under a learned generative prior. In this paradigm, a diffusion model is often trained exclusively on clean images, and the forward operator is incorporated at inference via data-consistency terms that guide reverse diffusion ( Chung et al., 2023a ; Song et al., 2022 ; Chung et al., 2023b ) . Because the generative prior is decoupled from the forward operator, a single trained model can theoretically accommodate any acquisition protocol, a flexibility shared by our approach. However, this comes at the cost of iterative inference, requiring hundreds to thousands of score evaluations per reconstruction, and a prior specific to the imaged distribution and the detector size.
blocks.zh: 第二类方法将重建作为后期采样,置于先天学问的遗传学之下。 在这一范式中,传播模型往往专门接受清洁图像的培训,通过数据一致性术语来推断前方操作者,指导反向传播(Chung等人,2023a); Song等人, 2022; Chung等人, 2023b.). 由于基因前置与前置操作器脱钩,一个单一的训练有素的模型理论上可以容纳任何收购协议,这是我们方法共享的灵活性. 然而,这是以反复推论为代价的,每次重建需要上百到上千个分数评价,并且是先前对图像分布和探测器大小的特有评价.

blocks.en: A foundation model for sparse-view tomography must satisfy several core requirements that existing supervised methods satisfy only in isolation: (R1) Agnosticism to the number and angular positions of input projections; (R2) Agnosticism to detector dimensions and volume resolution; (R3) Scalability to large images; (R4) Generalization across heterogeneous data distributions.
blocks.zh: 零视线摄影的基础模型必须满足若干核心要求,而现有受监督的方法只能孤立地满足这些要求: (R1)对输入预测的数量和角位置的不可知论; (R2)对探测器维度和体积分辨率的不可知论; (R3)对大图像的可伸缩性; (R4)对不同数据分布的泛化.

blocks.en: TomoTransformer fulfills all four requirements through three design choices: First, we formulate reconstruction in the disentangled back-projection space ( 5 ), casting unseen view prediction as a spatially aligned interpolation problem (R1) . Second, we treat each single-view back-projection as a token conditioned on its viewing angle to be processed by a transformer. This design enables a single model to ingest and predict an arbitrary number of views at arbitrary angles and detector resolutions (R1–R2) . Third, we tokenize local P × P P\times P patches rather than full back-projections, yielding a memory-efficient pipeline capable of scaling to large images and volumes of arbitrary size (R3) . Requirement (R4) is met by two factors: 1) working on local patches rather than full back-projections improves generalization by reducing the complexity of the prediction task and increasing the effective number of training samples ( Khorashadizadeh et al., 2025a ; Khorashadizadeh et al., 2025b ) and 2) training the model at scale on large-scale heterogeneous datasets.
blocks.zh: Tomo Transfer通过三种设计选择满足所有四项要求: 首先,我们在分散的反投影空间(5)中进行重建,将未见的预测作为空间对齐的内插问题(R1)进行投影。 第二,我们把每个单视反投影当作一个象征性的,以它的视角为条件,由变压器处理. 这种设计使得一个单一的模型能够在任意角度和探测器分辨率(R1-R2)上摄取和预测任意数量的视图. 第三,我们给本地P × P 时标注 P补丁而不是全反投射,产生一个内存高效的管道,能够缩放到大图像和任意大小(R3)的体积. 2. 需要(R4)有两个因素: 1) 进行局部补丁而不是完全反预测,通过减少预测任务的复杂性和增加培训样本的有效数量(Khorashadizadeh等人,2025年a;Khorashadizadeh等人,2025年b)和2),使模型在大规模多样性数据集上进行大规模培训,从而改进了概括性。

blocks.en: In this paper, we formulate the missing view prediction in the disentangled space ( 5 ): predicting a missing projection at θ ⋆ \theta_{\star} amounts to predicting a new slice 𝐛 ⋆ {\mathbf{b}}_{\star} from the observed slices { 𝐛 r } r = 1 R \{{\mathbf{b}}_{r}\}_{r=1}^{R} . Because every slice lives on the same N × N N\times N image grid and shares the same coordinate system, the interpolation is spatially aligned across views, a property the raw sinogram does not enjoy. As shown in Figure 1 , each back-projection 𝐛 r ∈ ℝ N × N {\mathbf{b}}_{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} is treated as a token conditioned on its projection angle θ r \theta_{r} . Through self-attention, TomoTransformer can process a variable number of input tokens at arbitrary angles and predict an arbitrary number of queried views { 𝐛 ^ q } q = 1 Q \{\hat{{\mathbf{b}}}_{q}\}_{q=1}^{Q} as output, without any change to the architecture.

blocks.en: TomoTransformer has an encoder-decoder architecture similar to masked autoencoders (MAE) ( He et al., 2022 ) . The encoder processes only the existing tokens, followed by the decoder, which takes the encoder’s output for the existing tokens together with a learnable tensor for the queried tokens to be generated. Unlike standard transformers, token positions in our framework are physical quantities: the position of token r r is its projection angle θ r \theta_{r} , a continuous coordinate rather than a discrete index. To represent the viewing geometry, we map each angle θ r \theta_{r} to Fourier positional embeddings { ( sin ⁡ ( k ​ θ r ) , cos ⁡ ( k ​ θ r ) ) } k = 1 F \bigl\{(\sin(k\theta_{r}),\cos(k\theta_{r}))\bigr\}_{k=1}^{F} . Because these features vary smoothly with θ r \theta_{r} , the embedding is defined at every real angle rather than only on a fixed grid, which is what enables the model to generalize to unseen target angles at test time. These embeddings encode each token’s absolute angle; the transformer blocks additionally condition attention on the relative geometry, adding a learned function of the pairwise angular difference θ r − θ r ′ \theta_{r}-\theta_{r^{\prime}} to the attention logits. We refer to this as geometric attention and detail it in Appendix A .

blocks.en: Unlike naive sinogram interpolation, which must process the entire projection simultaneously, operating in the disentangled space enables localized computation: because each pixel’s relevant measurements are spatially aligned, tokens do not need to span the full back-projection. As shown in Figure 1 (red boxes), we extract local patches 𝐭 r ∈ ℝ P × P {\mathbf{t}}_{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{P\times P} ( P ≪ N P\ll N ) from the full back-projections 𝐛 r {\mathbf{b}}_{r} to serve as input tokens. Processing P × P P\times P patches rather than full N × N N\times N projections drastically reduces memory consumption and computational overhead during training, making the model scalable to large images. Since the network operates exclusively on fixed-size P × P P\times P tokens, it is decoupled from the full image dimension N N and the detector resolution. A single model can thus be trained on and reconstruct datasets at their native resolutions without resampling to a uniform grid. Furthermore, predicting a localized back-projection patch from observed views represents a much simpler task than predicting entire back-projections for a fixed set of views. Finally, the model can train on a large number of local patches extracted from each image, improving generalization and robustness to distribution shifts ( Khorashadizadeh et al., 2025b ) .

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate TomoTransformer on sparse-view CT reconstruction tasks. We first describe the training dataset and the common experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价TomoTransformer的 " 少见的CT重建任务 " 。 我们首先描述了训练数据集和常见的实验设置.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en: To train a versatile model across diverse anatomical regions, we build a large heterogeneous dataset of medical and natural images. The medical component comprises chest CTs from LoDoPaB-CT ( Leuschner et al., 2021 ) and the COVID-19 subset of CTSpine1K ( Deng et al., 2021 ) , abdominal CTs from KiTS23 ( Heller et al., 2023 ) , and further thoracic, colonographic, and head-and-neck volumes from the MSD, COLONOG, and HNSCC subsets of CTSpine1K ( Deng et al., 2021 ) . To expand structural diversity beyond anatomy, we additionally include natural images from FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) and ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) as texture priors. Because TomoTransformer operates on local P × P P\times P tokens, no resampling to a common grid is required, so we use the axial slices of each dataset at their native resolutions, normalized per slice into a shared intensity band. In total, the training set comprises ∼ \sim 650k 2D slices: 570k CT slices from 1,340 volumes and 80k natural images. Since every slice contributes many patches, each paired with a freshly sampled set of projection angles, the model is exposed to a massive training set, which is essential for robust generalization to unseen anatomies and distributions.
blocks.zh: 为了在各种不同的解剖学区域中培养多功能模型,我们建立了一套庞大的医学和自然图像多样性数据集。 医疗部分包括来自LoDoPAB-CT的胸部CT(Leuschner等人,2021年)和CTspine1K的COVID-19子集(Deng等人,2021年),来自Kits23的腹腔CT(Heller等人,2023年),以及来自MSD、COLONOG和HNSCC子集(Deng等人,2021年)的进一步胸腔、结肠和颈部卷。 为了将结构多样性扩大到解剖之外,我们还将FFHQ(Karras等人,2019年)和ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)的自然图像作为纹理前缀。 由于TomoTransformer在本地P×P\times P令牌上运行,所以不需要再复制到一个共同的网格,所以我们使用每个数据集的轴切片在它们的原生分辨率上,每个片段正常化成一个共享的强度带. 训练集共包括\\sim 650k 2D切片:1 340卷的570k CT切片和80k自然图像. 由于每个切片都贡献了许多补丁,每个补丁都配有一组新采样的投影角度,该模型暴露在大规模训练集中,这对于强力概括到看不见的解剖和分布至关重要.

blocks.en: While the previous section evaluated TomoTransformer on a fixed sparse-view setup, we now consider a more realistic and challenging regime: training a single model to handle variable projection counts and arbitrary angular configurations. This flexible paradigm is precisely what TomoTransformer was designed to address (R1) . For this experiment, we compare against ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) as the baselines in the previous section were not designed for variable-view reconstruction. Unlike TomoTransformer, ViewTrans operates directly on the raw sinogram and tokenizes each view into a vector whose dimension equals the detector width; its architecture works only for a single detector size and image resolution and cannot process images with different dimensions. To ensure a fair comparison, we restrict this experiment to the LoDoPaB-CT dataset ( Leuschner et al., 2021 ) at its native 362 × 362 362\times 362 resolution across varying sparsity levels. At every training iteration we draw a dense grid size uniformly in [ 128,512 ] [128,512] and almost uniformly [ 20 % , 80 % ] [20\%,80\%] of them for the measured views, with a small random angular perturbation. TomoTransformer and ViewTrans have similar capacity ( ∼ \sim 12M parameters).
blocks.zh: 虽然上一节对TomoTransformer进行了固定的零星视野设置评价,但我们现在认为一个更现实和更具挑战性的制度:培训一个单一的模式来处理可变预测计数和任意角构型。 这种灵活的范式正是TomoTransformer设计用来解决(R1)的. 对于这一实验,我们比较了VideoTrans(Chen等人,2026年),因为上一节的基线不是为变量视图重建设计的. 与 TomoTransformer 不同的是, ViewTrans 直接在原始的星图上运行,并将每个视图标注成一个矢量,其维度等于探测器宽度;其架构只用于单个探测器大小和图像分辨率,无法处理不同维度的图像. 为了确保进行公平的比较,我们仅限于LoDoPaB-CT数据集(Leuschner等人,2021年),其原生的362×362 362\times 362分辨率跨不同孢子水平. 在每一次训练中,我们都会在[128,512][128,512]和几乎一致的[20%,80%][20\%,80\%]中为所测量的视图绘制一个密集的网格大小,并带有小的随机角扰动. TomoTransformer和VideoTrans具有相似的能力(\\sim 12M参数).

blocks.en: We next evaluate the pretrained models using two input sparsity levels: 128 128 and 64 64 measured projections, reconstructing a 256 256 -view target. Representative reconstructions are shown in Figure 6 , and full quantitative results (averaged over 32 32 test slices against the dense 256 256 -view FBP reference) are reported in Table 3 (Appendix). When given 128 128 input views, TomoTransformer significantly outperforms ViewTrans by a wide margin. The contrast becomes even stronger at 64 64 input views, an extremely sparse regime that poses a severe challenge for both models. While TomoTransformer maintains a strong quantitative lead, the visual difference in Figure 6 is even more dramatic. At 64 64 views, ViewTrans introduces heavy swirling washing-machine artifacts that do not exist in the reference. This failure mode in ViewTrans highlights a key architectural weakness: because it applies filtered back-projection after predicting missing views in the sinogram, small systematic errors in its predicted sinograms get amplified into structured image artifacts under heavy undersampling.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们用两个输入螺旋分级来评价预先训练的模型:128 128和64 64测量了预测,重建了256 256-视图目标. 图6显示了代表性重建,表3(附录)报告了全部量化结果(平均超过32,32个试验片与密集的256,256-view FBP参考)。 当给定128 128 个输入视图时, TomoTransformer 明显超标 View Translate 以宽边距。 在64个输入视图中,这种对比变得更加强烈,这种制度极为稀少,对两种模式都构成严峻挑战。 虽然TomoTransformer保持强大的定量领先,但图6中的视觉差异更为戏剧化. 在64个视图中,VideoTrans引入了参考文献中不存在的重纺洗衣机文物. ViewTrans中的这种失败模式突出了一个关键的建筑缺陷:因为它在预测了星系图中缺失的视图后应用了经过过滤的反投影,因此其预测的星系图中小的系统错误在沉重的下取样下被放大成结构化的图像文物.

blocks.zh: 5.4 零射断音

blocks.en: So far we considered noiseless measurements, with models trained on noiseless sinograms. What happens when the projections are noisy at inference time? This matters in practice, where the noise distribution varies across datasets and acquisition protocols and may be unseen at training time.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们考虑了无噪声测量, 模型训练无噪声的鼻镜。 当预测在推论时很吵时会发生什么? 这在实践中很重要,因为各种数据集和购置协议的噪音分布各不相同,在培训时可能看不见。

blocks.en: A single pass of TomoTransformer is already a denoiser. We consider our pre-trained TomoTransformer (varied) of Section 5.2 which is trained on noiseless projections and we apply it to noisy sparse-view projections; the network has never seen noise during training. In Figure 7 we show the results of applying the network to 128 128 noisy projections to predict 256 256 projections, under additive Gaussian noise at 45 45 dB and under a Poisson ⁡ ( I 0 ​ e − 𝐀𝐟 ) \mathrm{Poisson}\bigl(I_{0}e^{-{\mathbf{A}}{\mathbf{f}}}\bigr) photon-counting model with I 0 = 10 5 I_{0}=10^{5} incident photons per bin and a peak optical depth of 4 4 , log-transformed back before reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 托莫·Transformer的单传就已经是一个登场者了. 我们认为,我们经过预先训练的第5.2节的TomoTransformer(变种)接受了无噪声预测的培训,我们把它用于噪音的零星预测;该网络在训练期间从未见过噪音。 在图7中,我们显示将网络应用到128 128个噪音预测,预测256 256个预测,在45 dB的添加剂Gaussian噪声和Poisson ⁡ (I 0 e – Af )\mathrm{ Poisson }\bigl(I_{0}e^{ – maathbf{A}}{\mathbf{ f}}}\bigr)下 光子计数模型为I 0 = 10 5 I_{0}=10^{5}事件光子每桶,峰值光学深度为4 4 ,在重建前转换成日志.

blocks.en:
The second column of Figure 7 shows that the network predictions alone, without noisy measured views, not only do not show signs of hallucination under such distribution shift, but also yield reconstructions already much cleaner than the noisy FBP input (first column).
This is a remarkable property of the model, as it was never explicitly trained for denoising, yet it generalizes to this task due to its ability to capture the underlying structure of the data.
When we form the reconstruction from both predicted and measured views as usual, the residual noise in the reconstruction is dominated by the noisy measured views resulting in a lower PSNR, see the third column of Figure 7 .
blocks.zh:
图7的第二列显示,网络预测单独进行,没有吵闹的测量视图,不仅在这种分布转变下没有出现幻觉的迹象,而且产生的重建已经比吵闹的FBP输入(第一列)更清洁.
这是该模型的显著特性,因为它从未经过明确的解密训练,但由于它能够捕捉数据的基本结构,因此它概括了这项任务。

blocks.en:
The flexibility of TomoTransformer allows us to replace the noisy projections as well: Blind-spot re-masking (BS): we partition the measured angles into G G uniformly interleaved subsets and, for each, mask that subset, predicting it from the remaining noisy measurements.
The fourth column of Figure 7 shows that this approach can further improve the reconstruction quality. Complementary re-masking (CR): we invert the mask, so that the R total − R sparse R_{\text{total}}-R_{\text{sparse}} views predicted in the first pass become the input to predict the R sparse R_{\text{sparse}} measured angles. The final reconstruction is then formed by averaging the first-pass predictions and the second-pass replacements, effectively denoising both the measured and unmeasured views.
The fifth column of Figure 7 shows that this approach outperforms the blind-spot re-masking.
blocks.zh:
Tomo Transformer的灵活性也让我们可以取代吵闹的预测:盲点重现(BS):我们把测量的角度划为G G 统一互换的子集,对每个子集进行遮盖,从剩下的吵闹的测量中预测出来.
图7第四栏显示,这一办法可进一步提高重建质量。 补充的重现(CR):我们反转了面具,这样,在第一个传中预言的 R 总计 – R 稀疏的 R_{\text{total}}-R_{\text{sparse}} 视图就成为了预测 R 稀疏的 R_{\text{sparse}} 测量角度的输入. 然后通过平均第一通道的预测和第二通道的替换来形成最后的重建,有效地去除所测量的和未测量的两种观点.
图7第五栏显示,这一方法的效绩超过了盲点重现.

blocks.en: We trained TomoTransformer on the heterogeneous dataset of CT and natural images at their original resolutions and varying view counts (the eight datasets of Section 5.1 with the sampling scheme of Section 5.3 ). We already reported its performance in Section 5.2 (see Tables 1 and 2 ). To test zero-shot performance, now we apply it to a completely different domain: nanoscale X-ray imaging of mouse brain tissue ( Bosch et al., 2025 ) , which differs radically from medical CT in scale, contrast, and resolution. It was collected using ptychographic X-ray computed tomography (PXCT) at the cSAXS beamline (SLS/PSI). Even though this modality measures the refractive index instead of standard X-ray absorption, the physics still relies on the Radon transform.
blocks.zh: 我们对TomoTransformer进行了关于CT和自然图像原始分辨率和不同视点的不同数据集的培训(第5.1节的8个数据集和第5.3节的取样计划)。 我们已经在第5.2节中报告了执行情况(见表1和表2)。 为了测试零射的性能,我们现在把它应用到一个完全不同的领域:老鼠脑组织的纳米尺度X射线成像(Bosch等人,2025年),这在尺度、对比度和分辨率上与医学上的CT大相径庭。 它是在cSAXS束线(SLS/PSI)使用图谱X射线计算成像仪(PXCT)采集的. 尽管这种方式测量的是折射指数而不是标准X射线吸收,但物理学仍然依赖于拉顿变换.

blocks.en:
We apply our pre-trained TomoTransformer to the preprocessed ptychographic reconstructed projections of a mouse-brain pillar ( 617 617 views over [ 0 ∘ , 180 ∘ ) [0^{\circ},180^{\circ}) , 37.6 ​ nm 37.6\,\text{nm} pixels, 768 768 -pixel detector).
The dense 512 512 -view FBP of these measurements is the reference; the sparse 128 128 -view FBP is the input. Figure 8 shows that TomoTransformer generalizes seamlessly to this out-of-distribution data, recovering fine cellular structure with no fine-tuning. Querying more views from the same 128 128 measurements substantially improves quality further ( 128 → 256 128\to 256 vs. 128 → 512 128\to 512 ).
blocks.zh:
我们将我们经过预先训练的 Tomo Transfer 用于对一个鼠标脑柱进行预处理的图谱重构预测(617 617 查看 [0∘,180∘] [0^{\circ},180^{\circ}],37.6nm 37.6\,\text{nm}像素,768 768-像素探测器).
这些测量的密度512 512 - View FBP是参考;稀疏的128 - View FBP是输入. 图8显示,TOMOTransformer将这种分流数据无缝一般化,恢复精细的细胞结构,没有微调. 从同样的128个128个测量中征求更多看法,可大大提高质量(128 ~ 256 128\to 256 vs.128 → 512 128\to 512)。

blocks.en: The pretrained ViewTrans cannot be applied to these measurements, since its architecture is tied to the detector size and image resolution it was trained on. The baselines of Section 5.2 are likewise protocol-bound, but can at least be run in the single setting they were trained for, 64 → 256 64\to 256 views, albeit at projection angles that still differ from those seen during training. Figure 9 (Appendix) shows that TomoTransformer outperforms the baselines, while they hallucinate texture absent from the reference and leave severe blocking artifacts.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的 ViewTrans 无法应用于这些测量,因为它的架构与它所训练的探测器大小和图像分辨率有关. 第5.2节的基线同样受协议约束,但至少可以在他们接受过培训的单一环境下运行64 ~ 256 64\ 至 256种观点,尽管其投影角度仍然不同于培训期间所看到的观点。 图9(附录)显示,TomoTransformer的性能超过了基线,同时他们幻觉了参考文献中缺失的纹理,留下了严重的阻塞文物.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced TomoTransformer, a novel transformer-based architecture for sparse-view CT reconstruction. By disentangling the representation of projection angles and local back-projection patches, our model achieves robust performance across a variety of datasets and sparsity levels. Notably, TomoTransformer demonstrates remarkable generalization capabilities, effectively handling out-of-distribution data without fine-tuning. Future work will explore designing this architecture for other tomographic modalities including cone-beam CT.
blocks.zh: 在这份论文中,我们介绍了TomoTransformer(英语:Tomo Transformer),一种以变压器为基础的小说建筑,用于短视CT重建. 通过解析投影角度和局部反投影补丁的表示,我们的模型在各种数据集和溅射水平上实现了强劲的性能. 值得注意的是,TOMOTransformer显示出显著的通缩能力,在不进行微调的情况下有效处理分散数据. 今后的工作将探讨为包括圆锥束CT在内的其他地形学模式设计这一架构。

blocks.en: Each token is a local P × P P\times P patch ( P = 32 P=32 pixels) cropped from a single-view back-projection at its native resolution. Our geometric tokenizer (Section 4.1 ) samples each patch along its maximum- τ \tau diagonal chord at K = ⌈ P ​ 2 ⌉ = 46 K=\lceil P\sqrt{2}\rceil=46 equispaced points using bilinear interpolation. This reduces the P 2 = 1024 P^{2}=1024 pixels of the patch into a 46 46 -dimensional feature vector. A linear layer 𝐄 ∈ ℝ D × K \mathbf{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times K} then projects this feature to the transformer embedding dimension D = 512 D=512 . The detokenizer uses a linear layer 𝐄 ′ ∈ ℝ K × D \mathbf{E}^{\prime}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times D} followed by the reconstruction sweep described in Section 4.1 . blocks.en: In each training iteration, we sample a batch of 32 32 axial slices at their native resolutions from the dataset mixture described in Section 5.1 . Each slice is normalized to a common intensity range and masked with a circular field-of-view mask. We compute parallel-beam 2D projections using the Operator Discretization Library (ODL) ( Adler et al., 2017 ) , setting the detector width to match the image dimension. The resulting sinogram is ramp-filtered and back-projected view by view to create the disentangled tensor stack { 𝐛 r } \{{\mathbf{b}}_{r}\} , from which input patches are cropped.

blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: At inference, we reconstruct an image of arbitrary size N × N N\times N by dividing it into P × P P\times P patches with a stride of P P . Patches that extend past the image boundary are shifted inward to align with the edge, and any overlapping regions are simply averaged. For each patch, we insert the predicted tokens only at unobserved target positions, leaving measured views untouched to preserve exact data consistency. The final patch reconstruction is obtained by averaging across all R total R_{\text{total}} tokens, as in ( 4 ). Because the network processes patches of a fixed size ( P × P P\times P ), this pipeline is entirely independent of the image dimension N N and detector resolution. This spatial flexibility is precisely what allows our model, trained on resolutions up to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , to run directly on the 768 × 768 768\times 768 nanoscale brain volume in Section 5.5 without any architectural changes.
blocks.zh: 推论中,我们重建了一个任意大小的N×N\times N的图像,将其分为P×P\times的补丁,并配以PP的脚步. 延伸过图像边界的补丁会向内移,以与边缘对齐,任何重叠区域都只是平均。 对于每个补丁,我们仅在未观测到的目标位置插入预测的符号,使测量到的视图保持不变,以保持准确的数据一致性。 最终补丁重建是通过所有RQQText {totalQQ 令牌的平均值获得的,如(4). 由于网络处理的补丁具有固定大小(P×P\times P),这个管道完全独立于图像维度N和探测器分辨率. 这种空间灵活性正是使我们的模型在分辨率最高达512×512 512\times 512的情况下可以直接运行在第5.5节的768×768768\times 768纳米尺度的大脑体积上,而没有任何建筑改变。

blocks.en: D.1 Image-domain post-processing baselines

blocks.en: We compare against several established image-domain post-processing networks: U-Net ( Jin et al., 2017 ) , DRUNet ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) , NAFNet ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Restormer ( Zamir et al., 2022 ) , and CTformer ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . These models are trained to map a sparse-view FBP patch to its dense-view counterpart. They share the exact same training data, ramp filter, and back-projection operator as TomoTransformer, differing only in the neural architecture used for enhancement. At test time, all baselines are applied patch-wise using the identical tiling, stride, and overlap-averaging scheme (Section C ), making them resolution-independent.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了几个既定的图像域后处理网络:U-Net(Jin等人,2017年),DRUNet(Zhang等人,2021年),NAFNet(Chen等人,2022年),Reformer (Zamir等人,2022年),和CTFOR(王等人,2023年). 这些模型经过培训,可以将一个稀疏的视野FBP补丁映射到它的稠密视野对应物. 他们分享与TomoTransformer完全相同的训练数据,坡道滤波器和后投影操作员,仅在用于增强的神经架构上有所不同. 在测试时,所有基线都采用相同的板块、脚步和重叠重叠法(C节),从而实现解析独立。

blocks.en: All baselines are trained on P × P P\times P patches ( P = 32 P=32 ), matching TomoTransformer’s token size, to ensure identical spatial context. The only exception is CTformer, whose public implementation hard-codes a 64 × 64 64\times 64 unfold/fold tokenizer grid. All baselines share TomoTransformer’s optimization recipe described in Section B : optimizer, learning rate, schedule, gradient clipping and iteration count. The objective necessarily differs: a post-processing network maps the sparse-view FBP patch to the dense-view FBP patch and is trained with an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss in the image domain, whereas TomoTransformer is supervised per projection on the unobserved views only.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都用P×P P\times P补丁(P=32 P=32)进行训练,匹配TomoTransformer的符号大小,以确保相同的空间背景. 唯一的例外是CTformer,其公开执行硬码为64×6464\times 64 explain/brew 代碼器网格. 所有基线都共享TomoTransformer在B节描述的优化配方:优化器,学习率,时间表,梯度剪切和迭代计数. 目标必然不同:一个处理后网络将稀有视图的FBP补丁映射到稠密视图的FBP补丁上,并接受图像域 l1\ell\%1}丢失的训练,而TomoTransformer只在未观察的视图上监督每个投影.

blocks.en: D.2 ViewTrans baseline
blocks.zh: D.2 观点转换基线

blocks.en: ViewTrans ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is a sinogram-domain baseline that treats each projection view (a full row of the sinogram across all detector bins) as an individual token. We reimplement the original architecture using its view-as-token sequence representation, a cascade of 5 5 pre-LayerNorm encoders starting with a geometry-aware self-attention (G-MSA) block, a pseudo-full-view input generated by linear view interpolation, a differentiable FBP head, and an image-domain ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss. To adapt the baseline to our setup fairly, we make the following modifications: • Parallel-beam geometry encoding. The G-MSA block constructs queries and keys by concatenating layer-normalized sinogram features with three geometry maps. Because parallel-beam geometry lacks a fan angle, we replace the original tan ⁡ ( γ i ) \tan(\gamma_{i}) detector encoding with the normalized detector coordinate t i ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] t_{i}\in[-1,1] matching our projection operator. The angular map cos ⁡ ( β j ) \cos(\beta_{j}) and the binary observed/interpolated indicator remain unchanged. • Decoupling attention width from M M . ViewTrans sets its token dimension equal to the detector width M M , tying the architecture to a single resolution. We benchmark at LoDoPaB-CT’s native resolution ( M = 362 M=362 ), which is not divisible by the attention head count. To resolve this, we decouple the inner attention dimension H ⋅ d H\cdot d from M M and project features back to ℝ M \mathbb{R}^{M} for the residual skip connection. Using the original head counts ( 4 4 for G-MSA, 8 8 for standard blocks), a head dimension of 128 128 , and an MLP ratio of 4.0 4.0 , the model contains 13.06 ​ M 13.06\,\text{M} parameters, closely matching TomoTransformer’s 12.71 ​ M 12.71\,\text{M} . • Shared reconstruction operator. We build the differentiable FBP head using the exact same ramp filter and back-projection operator as TomoTransformer, supervising predictions against dense-view FBPs generated by this operator. This ensures both models operate within an identical reconstruction domain. • Training schedule. Because our training runs are longer than those in the original paper, we replace the StepLR schedule with a cosine decay to zero. We train using Adam at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and 8 8 slices per gradient step for 10 6 10^{6} iterations, matching TomoTransformer’s training length. ViewTrans is trained on LoDoPaB-CT under the same dynamic sparse-view schedule as TomoTransformer, ensuring an identical experimental comparison.
